verses.original: שָׁמוֹר֙ אֶת־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֔יב וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פֶּ֔סַח לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֞י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֗יב הוֹצִ֨יאֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mō·wr ’eṯ- ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā pe·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kî bə·ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ hō·w·ṣî·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mim·miṣ·ra·yim lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night
verses.literalPt: GUARDA o mês de Abibe, e celebra a páscoa ao SENHOR teu Deus; porque no mês de Abibe o SENHOR teu Deus te tirou do Egito, de noite.

verses.original: וְזָבַ֥חְתָּ פֶּ֛סַח לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֑ר בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḇaḥ·tā pe·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām
verses.literal: You are to offer to the LORD your God the Passover sacrifice from the herd or flock in the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name . . .
verses.literalPt: Então sacrificarás a páscoa ao SENHOR teu Deus, das ovelhas e das vacas, no lugar que o SENHOR escolher para ali fazer habitar o seu nome.

verses.original: לֹא־ תֹאכַ֤ל עָלָיו֙ חָמֵ֔ץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים תֹּֽאכַל־ עָלָ֥יו מַצּ֖וֹת לֶ֣חֶם עֹ֑נִי כִּ֣י בְחִפָּז֗וֹן יָצָ֙אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכֹּר֔ אֶת־ י֤וֹם צֵֽאתְךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯō·ḵal ‘ā·lāw ḥā·mêṣ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal- ‘ā·lāw maṣ·ṣō·wṯ le·ḥem ‘ō·nî kî ḇə·ḥip·pā·zō·wn yā·ṣā·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lə·ma·‘an tiz·kōr ’eṯ- yō·wm ṣê·ṯə·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim kōl yə·mê ḥay·ye·ḵā
verses.literal: You must not eat leavened bread with it for seven days you are to eat with it unleavened bread the bread of affliction because you left the land of Egypt in haste so that you may remember - for the rest of your life the day you left the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Nela não comerás levedado; sete dias nela comerás pães ázimos, pão de aflição (porquanto apressadamente saíste da terra do Egito), para que te lembres do dia da tua saída da terra do Egito, todos os dias da tua vida.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֥ שְׂאֹ֛ר בְּכָל־ גְּבֻלְךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא־ יָלִ֣ין מִן־ הַבָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּעֶ֛רֶב בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yê·rā·’eh lə·ḵā śə·’ōr bə·ḵāl gə·ḇul·ḵā šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·lō- yā·lîn min- hab·bā·śār ’ă·šer tiz·baḥ bā·‘e·reḇ bay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn lab·bō·qer
verses.literal: No leaven is to be found in all your land for seven days and none of the meat you sacrifice in the evening of the first day shall remain until morning
verses.literalPt: Levedado não aparecerá contigo por sete dias em todos os teus termos; também da carne que matares à tarde, no primeiro dia, nada ficará até à manhã.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִזְבֹּ֣חַ אֶת־ הַפָּ֑סַח בְּאַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯū·ḵal liz·bō·aḥ ’eṯ- hap·pā·saḥ bə·’a·ḥaḏ šə·‘ā·re·ḵā ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: You are not . . . to sacrifice the Passover animal in any of the towns that the LORD your God is giving you
verses.literalPt: Não poderás sacrificar a páscoa em nenhuma das tuas portas que te dá o SENHOR teu Deus;

verses.original: כִּ֠י אִֽם־ אֶל־ הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֔וֹ שָׁ֛ם תִּזְבַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַפֶּ֖סַח בָּעָ֑רֶב כְּב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מוֹעֵ֖ד צֵֽאתְךָ֥ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām tiz·baḥ ’eṯ- hap·pe·saḥ bā·‘ā·reḇ kə·ḇō·w haš·še·meš mō·w·‘êḏ ṣê·ṯə·ḵā mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: You must only . . . offer the Passover sacrifice at the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name . . . Do this in the evening as the sun sets at the same time you departed from Egypt
verses.literalPt: Senão no lugar que escolher o SENHOR teu Deus, para fazer habitar o seu nome, ali sacrificarás a páscoa à tarde, ao pôr do sol, ao tempo determinado da tua saída do Egito.

verses.original: וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֙ וְאָ֣כַלְתָּ֔ בַּמָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּ֑וֹ וּפָנִ֣יתָ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ לְאֹהָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·šal·tā wə·’ā·ḵal·tā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bōw ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯā ḇab·bō·qer wə·hā·laḵ·tā lə·’ō·hā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: And you shall roast it and eat it in the place the LORD your God will choose and in the morning you shall return to your tents
verses.literalPt: Então a cozerás, e comerás no lugar que escolher o SENHOR teu Deus; depois voltarás pela manhã, e irás às tuas tendas.

verses.original: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצּ֑וֹת וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י עֲצֶ֙רֶת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מְלָאכָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ‘ă·ṣe·reṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō ṯa·‘ă·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: For six days you must eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day you shall hold a solemn assembly to the LORD your God and you must not do any work
verses.literalPt: Seis dias comerás pães ázimos e no sétimo dia é solenidade ao SENHOR teu Deus; nenhum trabalho farás.

verses.original: שִׁבְעָ֥ה שָׁבֻעֹ֖ת תִּסְפָּר־ לָ֑ךְ מֵהָחֵ֤ל חֶרְמֵשׁ֙ בַּקָּמָ֔ה תָּחֵ֣ל לִסְפֹּ֔ר שִׁבְעָ֖ה שָׁבֻעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘āh šā·ḇu·‘ōṯ tis·pār- lāḵ mê·hā·ḥêl ḥer·mêš baq·qā·māh tā·ḥêl lis·pōr šiḇ·‘āh šā·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: You are to count off seven weeks from . . . the time you first put the sickle . . . to the standing grain . . .
verses.literalPt: Sete semanas contarás; desde que a foice começar na seara iniciarás a contar as sete semanas.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חַ֤ג שָׁבֻעוֹת֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מִסַּ֛ת נִדְבַ֥ת יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְבָרֶכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥaḡ šā·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mis·saṯ niḏ·ḇaṯ yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ă·šer tit·tên ka·’ă·šer yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God . . . with a freewill offering . . . that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God has blessed you
verses.literalPt: Depois celebrarás a festa das semanas ao SENHOR teu Deus; o que deres será oferta voluntária da tua mão, segundo o SENHOR teu Deus te houver abençoado.

verses.original: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבִתֶּךָ֮ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶךָ֒ וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ בַּמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·maḥ·tā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’at·tāh ū·ḇin·ḵā ū·ḇit·te·ḵā wə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·hal·lê·wî ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā wə·hag·gêr wə·hay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer bə·qir·be·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·šak·kên šə·mōw šām
verses.literal: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place He . . . will choose as a dwelling for His Name . . . you your sons and daughters your menservants and maidservants and the Levite within your gates as well as the foreigner the fatherless and the widows among you
verses.literalPt: E te alegrarás perante o SENHOR teu Deus, tu, e teu filho, e tua filha, e o teu servo, e a tua serva, e o levita que está dentro das tuas portas, e o estrangeiro, e o órfão, e a viúva, que estão no meio de ti, no lugar que o SENHOR teu Deus escolher para ali fazer habitar o seu nome.

verses.original: וְזָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי־ עֶ֥בֶד הָיִ֖יתָ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ וְעָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת־ הַֽחֻקִּ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî- ‘e·ḇeḏ hā·yî·ṯā bə·miṣ·rā·yim wə·šā·mar·tā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- ha·ḥuq·qîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and carefully follow these statutes
verses.literalPt: E lembrar-te-ás de que foste servo no Egito; e guardarás estes estatutos, e os cumprirás.

verses.original: חַ֧ג הַסֻּכֹּ֛ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בְּאָ֨סְפְּךָ֔ מִֽגָּרְנְךָ֖ וּמִיִּקְבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaḡ has·suk·kōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh lə·ḵā šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm bə·’ā·sə·pə·ḵā mig·gā·rə·nə·ḵā ū·mî·yiq·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: You are to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress
verses.literalPt: A festa dos tabernáculos celebrarás sete dias, quando tiveres colhido da tua eira e do teu lagar.

verses.original: וְשָׂמַחְתָּ֖ בְּחַגֶּ֑ךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֤ וּבִתֶּ֙ךָ֙ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וְהַלֵּוִ֗י וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·maḥ·tā bə·ḥag·ge·ḵā ’at·tāh ū·ḇin·ḵā ū·ḇit·te·ḵā wə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā wə·hal·lê·wî wə·hag·gêr wə·hay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer biš·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: And you shall rejoice in your feast you your sons and daughters your menservants and maidservants and the Levite as well as the foreigner the fatherless and the widows among you
verses.literalPt: E, na tua festa, alegrar-te-ás, tu, e teu filho, e tua filha, e o teu servo, e a tua serva, e o levita, e o estrangeiro, e o órfão, e a viúva, que estão dentro das tuas portas.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תָּחֹג֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י יְבָרֶכְךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בְּכֹ֤ל תְּבוּאָֽתְךָ֙ וּבְכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔יךָ וְהָיִ֖יתָ אַ֥ךְ שָׂמֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tā·ḥōḡ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yiḇ·ḥar Yah·weh kî yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵōl tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā ’aḵ śā·mê·aḥ
verses.literal: For seven days you shall celebrate a feast to the LORD your God in the place He will choose because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands so that your joy will be complete
verses.literalPt: Sete dias celebrarás a festa ao SENHOR teu Deus, no lugar que o SENHOR escolher; porque o SENHOR teu Deus te há de abençoar em toda a tua colheita, e em todo o trabalho das tuas mãos; por isso certamente te alegrarás.

verses.original: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֡ה יֵרָאֶ֨ה כָל־ זְכוּרְךָ֜ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֔ר בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֣ג הַסֻּכּ֑וֹת וְלֹ֧א יֵרָאֶ֛ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lō·wōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh yê·rā·’eh ḵāl zə·ḵū·rə·ḵā ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiḇ·ḥār bə·ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ḥaḡ haš·šā·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ḥaḡ has·suk·kō·wṯ wə·lō yê·rā·’eh ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh rê·qām
verses.literal: Three times a year all your men . . . are to appear before the LORD your God in the place He will choose at the Feast of Unleavened Bread the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles No one should appear . . . before the LORD empty-handed
verses.literalPt: Três vezes no ano todo o homem entre ti aparecerá perante o SENHOR teu Deus, no lugar que escolher, na festa dos pães ázimos, e na festa das semanas, e na festa dos tabernáculos; porém não aparecerá vazio perante o SENHOR;

verses.original: אִ֖ישׁ כְּמַתְּנַ֣ת יָד֑וֹ כְּבִרְכַּ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־ לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’îš kə·mat·tə·naṯ yā·ḏōw kə·ḇir·kaṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer nā·ṯan- lāḵ
verses.literal: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you
verses.literalPt: Cada um, conforme ao dom da sua mão, conforme a bênção do SENHOR teu Deus, que lhe tiver dado.

verses.original: שֹׁפְטִ֣ים וְשֹֽׁטְרִ֗ים תִּֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֙ בְּכָל־ שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לִשְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם מִשְׁפַּט־ צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: šō·p̄ə·ṭîm wə·šō·ṭə·rîm tit·ten- lə·ḵā bə·ḵāl šə·‘ā·re·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā liš·ḇā·ṭe·ḵā wə·šā·p̄ə·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām miš·paṭ- ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you They are to judge the people with righteous judgment
verses.literalPt: Juízes e oficiais porás em todas as tuas cidades que o SENHOR teu Deus te der entre as tuas tribos, para que julguem o povo com juízo de justiça.

verses.original: לֹא־ תַטֶּ֣ה מִשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹ֥א תַכִּ֖יר פָּנִ֑ים וְלֹא־ תִקַּ֣ח שֹׁ֔חַד כִּ֣י הַשֹּׁ֗חַד יְעַוֵּר֙ עֵינֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים וִֽיסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯaṭ·ṭeh miš·pāṭ lō ṯak·kîr pā·nîm wə·lō- ṯiq·qaḥ šō·ḥaḏ kî haš·šō·ḥaḏ yə·‘aw·wêr ‘ê·nê ḥă·ḵā·mîm wî·sal·lêp̄ diḇ·rê ṣad·dî·qim
verses.literal: Do not deny justice or show partiality . . . . . . Do not accept a bribe for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous
verses.literalPt: Não torcerás o juízo, não farás acepção de pessoas, nem receberás peitas; porquanto a peita cega os olhos dos sábios, e perverte as palavras dos justos.

verses.original: צֶ֥דֶק צֶ֖דֶק תִּרְדֹּ֑ף לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיֶה֙ וְיָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣe·ḏeq ṣe·ḏeq tir·dōp̄ lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yeh wə·yā·raš·tā ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ
verses.literal: Pursue justice and justice alone so that you may live and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you
verses.literalPt: A justiça, somente a justiça seguirás; para que vivas, e possuas em herança a terra que te dará o SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִטַּ֥ע לְךָ֛ אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה כָּל־ עֵ֑ץ אֵ֗צֶל מִזְבַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiṭ·ṭa‘ lə·ḵā ’ă·šê·rāh kāl- ‘êṣ ’ê·ṣel miz·baḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Não plantarás nenhuma árvore junto ao altar do SENHOR teu Deus, que fizeres para ti.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מַצֵּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯā·qîm lə·ḵā maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh ’ă·šer śā·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar which the LORD your God hates
verses.literalPt: Nem levantarás imagem, a qual o SENHOR teu Deus odeia.
